selection: Fixed alpha and methods before this run; no validation selection
features: Six previous-interval values, six previous-day values, sine and cosine of known clock
daily_missing_rule: If any household is missing at a daily lag, all six use last observed interval
horizon: Remaining steps of the same 16-step episode; recursive Ridge forecasts
controller: Same community MPC with only net-load forecast replaced
primary_outcome: Total community cost over the same 44 eligible episodes
metrics: First-step MAE, all-horizon-occurrence MAE, cost, throughput, household savings, physical residuals
oracle: Uses future measurements and is non-causal; informational benchmark only
independence: Repeated forecasts and episodes do not add households or independent test days
